top_signals.title: Washington Is Buying Its Way Out of China's Tungsten Grip
top_signals.summary: Washington has signed tungsten deals worth up to $2.45 billion this year to build supply that does not depend on China, ahead of a Pentagon ban on Chinese-origin tungsten that takes effect on January 1. From that date, defense contractors can no longer deliver tungsten that was mined, refined, or separated in China, Russia, Iran, or North Korea, which closes the loophole that let them clear the old restrictions by finishing production elsewhere.
